headline: Fronts Cool as Fisherman’s Row Rekindles Action
war_summary: The latest returns show a pause across the heaviest fronts, though FishermansRowHex has stirred anew. WeatheredExpanseHex recorded 51 strategic-base events in the past day, down from the previous edition’s 57, but none in the latest two hours; its casualty and enlistment rates are cooling, with six Warden and three Colonial bases reported. CallahansPassageHex remains a major furnace at 31 daily events and six in six hours, yet its latest two-hour ledger is quiet, with eight Warden and two Colonial bases. StlicanShelfHex holds 18 daily events, six in six hours, and likewise no fresh movement in the last two; its combat rates are easing. MooringCountyHex has 12 daily events and five in six hours, with no latest two-hour events, although both casualty streams are accelerating and the balance remains ten Warden to two Colonial bases. FishermansRowHex, by contrast, has risen to 32 daily events, including three in the latest two hours, with six Colonial, two Warden, and one unclaimed base. LinnMercyHex shows only three daily events and no new movement in the latest two hours. These six sectors furnish the clearest records for near-term base changes.
